items.text: Norway reached the quarter-finals for the first time, beating Brazil 2-1.
Julio Enciso scored Paraguay's first ever knockout-phase goal, against Germany, after five previous scoreless knockout matches.
Morocco became the first African team to reach the quarter-finals twice.
Yūto Nagatomo became the first AFC player to appear in five editions, against Sweden.
Argentina became the third team to reach 50 World Cup wins, after Brazil and Germany, with victory over Jordan.
Egypt won a World Cup knockout match for the first time, on penalties against Australia.
Congo DR took their first ever World Cup point, drawing with Portugal.
Lionel Messi scored his first World Cup hat-trick, against Austria, the first of the tournament by any player.
The USA scored four goals in a World Cup match for the first time, against Paraguay.
Mexico became the first Concacaf nation to win 20 World Cup matches, against Czechia.
Guillermo Ochoa became the oldest player to appear for a Concacaf nation at 40 years and 346 days.
Uruguay v Cabo Verde was the first World Cup match featuring two 40-year-olds, goalkeepers Vozinha and Fernando Muslera.
Côte d'Ivoire qualified for the knockout phase for the first time, beating Curaçao.
Qatar earned their first World Cup point in their fourth ever match.
Ali Olwan became Jordan's first ever World Cup goalscorer, against Austria.
Egypt progressed from a World Cup group for the first time after a 1-1 draw with IR Iran.
Canada took their first ever World Cup point in their seventh match, against Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Senegal became the first African team to score five goals in a World Cup match, against Iraq.
Canada won their first ever World Cup match, against Qatar, and became the first nation outside Europe and South America to score six in a match.
Egypt won their first ever World Cup match in their ninth fixture, against New Zealand.
Cabo Verde were the only debutant to reach the knockouts, unbeaten over 90 minutes across four draws despite facing Argentina, Spain and Uruguay.
Jordan were the only 2026 debutant to score in all three group matches.

sections.title: Host Cities
sections.standfirst: Across 16 host cities in Canada, Mexico and the United States, the tournament turned communities into the centre of the sporting world.
sections.note: City-level figures are held in the top-level hostCities array.

hostCities.name: Dallas
hostCities.note: Hosted the International Broadcast Centre. Most matches of any host city.

hostCities.name: Los Angeles
hostCities.note: Hosted one of the three opening ceremonies, themed Creativity.

hostCities.name: Miami
hostCities.note: Hosted the Bronze Final. Highest-scoring single match of the tournament at 10 goals.

hostCities.name: New York/New Jersey
hostCities.note: Hosted the final, the closing ceremony and the first World Cup final halftime show. Highest total attendance of any host city. Highest hot dog sales.

hostCities.name: San Francisco Bay Area
hostCities.note: Fewest goals of any host city. Third-highest hot dog sales.

hostCities.name: Guadalajara
hostCities.note: Largest host city WhatsApp channel at 212,000 followers. Highest transportation spending growth per Visa data.

hostCities.name: Mexico City
hostCities.note: Hosted the opening match and one of the three opening ceremonies, themed Origin. Highest beer sales of any venue. Recorded 147 decibels and seismic activity on a Mexico goal.

hostCities.name: Toronto
hostCities.note: Hosted one of the three opening ceremonies, themed Community. Hot dog figure is as published by FIFA and is by far the lowest of any host city.

derived.note: Calculated from the published figures, not published by FIFA. Useful for cross-checks and for callout cards.

crossChecks.note: Host city goal figures sum to two more than the published tournament total. FIFA does not explain the difference. Treat 308 as authoritative.
Host city beer figures sum to 17,133 fewer than the published total. Likely non-stadium or hospitality sales counted separately.
Published total is rounded to 4.62 million, so the gap is consistent with rounding.

derived.socialViewGrowthVsAbuseGrowth: Video views grew roughly 8x versus Qatar 2022 while intercepted harmful posts grew roughly 19x

dataGaps.note: Figures absent from the FIFA recap. Useful as an editorial layer or as an explicit 'not published' state in the UI.
